description_zh: 2019年2月28日下午2:06，一辆Lyft自动驾驶车辆在手动模式下于Mountain View等待保护左转时，被后方车辆以极低速度追尾。后车驾驶员同时踩下油门和刹车。选择后车作为自车（ego），前车为静止车辆NPC，测试在有交通信号灯的路口后车能否避免追尾。

source_snippets: a Lyft Autonomous Vehicle (“Lyft AV”), operating in manual mode, was struck at very low speed from behind by a 3rd party passenger vehicle while waiting to make a protected left turn
The driver of the Lyft AV had been inched forward after being stopped at a red light for approximately 105 seconds
The driver of the 3rd party passenger vehicle verbally stated that she had pressed both the accelerator and the brake pedal simultaneously
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: VEH 1: STOPPED (checked), VEH 2: PROCEEDING STRAIGHT (checked)
TYPE OF COLLISION: VEH 1: REAR END (checked), VEH 2: HEAD-ON (checked)
evidence.reason: 后车（VEH2）移动且主动追尾，有测试价值；前车静止，场景适合用stopped_ahead表达。
